meta.name: Open Targets GraphQL & REST API Beta

Query.name: Query
Query.description: Root query type providing access to all entities and search functionality in the Open Targets Platform. Supports retrieval of targets, diseases, drugs, variants, studies, credible sets, and their associations. Includes full-text search, mapping, and filtering capabilities.

fields.name: meta
fields.description: Open Targets API metadata, including version and configuration information

fields.name: target
fields.description: Retrieve a target (gene/protein) by target identifier (e.g. ENSG00000139618)

fields.name: targets
fields.description: Retrieve multiple targets by target identifiers

fields.name: disease
fields.description: Retrieve a disease or phenotype by identifier (e.g. EFO_0000400)

fields.name: diseases
fields.description: Retrieve multiple diseases by disease or phenotype identifiers

fields.name: drug
fields.description: Retrieve a drug or clinical candidate by identifier (e.g. CHEMBL112)

fields.name: drugs
fields.description: Retrieve multiple drugs or clinical candidates by identifiers

fields.name: search
fields.description: Full-text, multi-entity search across all types of entities (targets, diseases, drugs, variants or studies)

fields.name: facets
fields.description: Search sets of targets or diseases used to facet associations

fields.name: mapIds
fields.description: Map free-text terms to canonical IDs used as primary identifiers in the Platform (targets, diseases, drugs, variants or studies). For example, mapping 'diabetes' to EFO_0000400 or 'BRCA1' to ENSG00000139618

fields.name: associationDatasources
fields.description: List of available evidence datasources and their datatypes

fields.name: interactionResources
fields.description: List of molecular interaction resources and their versions

fields.name: geneOntologyTerms
fields.description: Fetch Gene Ontology terms by GO identifiers

fields.name: variant
fields.description: Retrieve a variant by identifier in the format of CHROM_POS_REF_ALT for SNPs and short indels (e.g. 19_44908684_T_C)

fields.name: study
fields.description: Retrieve a GWAS or molecular QTL study by ID (e.g. GCST004131)

fields.name: studies
fields.description: List GWAS or molecular QTL studies filtered by ID(s) and/or disease(s); supports ontology expansion

fields.name: credibleSet
fields.description: Retrieve a 95% credible set (study-locus) by identifier

fields.name: credibleSets
fields.description: List credible sets filtered by study-locus IDs, study IDs, variant IDs, study types or regions

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.description: Pagination settings for controlling result set size and page navigation. Uses zero-based indexing to specify which page of results to retrieve.

inputFields.name: size
inputFields.description: Number of items per page [Default: 25, Max: 3000]

Disease.name: Disease
Disease.description: Core annotation for diseases or phenotypes. A disease or phenotype in the Platform is understood as any disease, phenotype, biological process or measurement that might have any type of causality relationship with a human target. The EMBL-EBI Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) (slim version) is used as scaffold for the disease or phenotype entity.

AssociatedTargets.name: AssociatedTargets
AssociatedTargets.description: Target-disease associations computed on-the-fly using configurable datasource weights and evidence filters. Returns associations with aggregated scores and evidence counts supporting the target-disease relationship.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Total number of target-disease associations matching the query filters

fields.name: datasources
fields.description: List of datasource settings with weights and propagation rules used to compute the associations

fields.name: rows
fields.description: List of associated targets with their association scores and evidence breakdowns

fields.name: datasourceScores
fields.description: Association scores computed for every datasource (e.g., IMPC, ChEMBL, Gene2Phenotype)

fields.name: novelty
fields.description: A measure of how novel the target–disease association is, calculated based on the accumulation of evidence over time

fields.name: score
fields.description: Overall association score aggregated across all evidence types. A higher score indicates a stronger association between the target and the disease. Scores are normalized to a range of 0-1.

fields.name: datatypeScores
fields.description: Association scores computed for every datatype (e.g., Genetic associations, Somatic, Literature)

fields.name: target
fields.description: Associated target entity

ScoredComponent.name: ScoredComponent
ScoredComponent.description: Scored component used in association scoring

fields.name: id
fields.description: Component identifier (e.g., datatype or datasource name)

fields.name: score
fields.description: Association score for the component. Scores are normalized to a range of 0-1. The higher the score, the stronger the association.

Target.name: Target
Target.description: Core annotation for drug targets (gene/proteins). Targets are defined based on EMBL-EBI Ensembl database and uses the Ensembl gene ID as the  primary identifier. An Ensembl gene ID is considered potential drug target if included in the canonical assembly or if present alternative assemblies but encoding for a reviewed protein product according to the UniProt database.

fields.description: Pathway annotations for the target

fields.name: approvedSymbol
fields.description: Approved gene symbol of the target

fields.name: chemicalProbes
fields.description: Chemical probes with high selectivity and specificity for the target.

fields.name: tractability

fields.name: nameSynonyms

fields.name: dbXrefs

fields.name: approvedName

fields.name: genomicLocation

fields.name: subcellularLocations

fields.name: geneticConstraint

fields.name: homologues

fields.name: transcriptIds

fields.name: obsoleteNames

fields.name: proteinIds

fields.name: geneOntology
fields.description: List of Gene Ontology (GO) annotations related to the target

fields.name: safetyLiabilities
fields.description: Known target safety effects and target safety risk information

fields.name: transcripts
fields.description: List of transcripts associated with the target including protein and structure annotations

fields.name: alternativeGenes
fields.description: List of alternative Ensembl gene identifiers mapped to non-canonical chromosomes

fields.name: hallmarks
fields.description: Hallmarks related to the target gene sourced from COSMIC

fields.name: synonyms
fields.description: List of synonyms for the target gene

fields.name: credibleSets
fields.description: 95% credible sets for GWAS and molQTL studies. Credible sets include all variants in the credible set as well as the fine-mapping method and statistics used to estimate the credible set.

fields.name: similarEntities
fields.description: Return similar labels using a model Word2CVec trained with PubMed

fields.name: literatureOcurrences
fields.description: Return the list of publications that mention the main entity, alone or in combination with other entities

fields.name: evidences
fields.description: Target-disease evidence from all data sources supporting associations between this target and diseases or phenotypes. Evidence entries are reported and scored according to confidence in the association.

fields.name: interactions
fields.description: Molecular interactions reporting experimental or functional interactions between this target and other molecules. Interactions are integrated from multiple databases capturing physical interactions (e.g., IntAct), directional interactions (e.g., Signor), pathway relationships (e.g., Reactome), or functional interactions (e.g., STRINGdb).

fields.name: mousePhenotypes
fields.description: Mouse phenotype information linking this human target to observed phenotypes in mouse models. Provides data on phenotypes observed when the target gene is modified in mouse models.

fields.name: baselineExpression
fields.description: Baseline expression

fields.name: associatedDiseases
fields.description: Target-disease associations calculated on-the-fly using configurable data source weights and evidence filters. Returns associations with aggregated scores and evidence counts supporting the target-disease relationship.

fields.name: prioritisation
fields.description: Target-specific properties used to prioritise targets for further investigation. Prioritisation factors cover several areas around clinical precedence, tractability, do-ability, and safety of the target. Values range from -1 (unfavourable/deprioritised) to 1 (favourable/prioritised).

fields.name: isEssential
fields.description: Flag indicating whether this target is essential based on CRISPR screening data from cancer cell line models. Essential genes are those that show dependency when knocked out in cellular models.

fields.name: depMapEssentiality
fields.description: Essentiality measurements extracted from DepMap, stratified by tissue or anatomical units. Gene essentiality is assessed based on dependencies exhibited when knocking out genes in cancer cellular models using CRISPR screenings from the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) Project. Gene effects below -1 can be considered dependencies.

fields.name: pharmacogenomics
fields.description: Pharmacogenomics data linking genetic variants affecting this target to drug responses. Data is integrated from sources including ClinPGx and describes how genetic variants influence individual drug responses when targeting this gene product.

fields.name: proteinCodingCoordinates
fields.description: Protein coding coordinates linking variants affecting this target to their amino acid-level consequences in protein products. Describes variant consequences at the protein level including amino acid changes and their positions for this target.

Drug.name: Drug
Drug.description: Core annotation for drug or clinical candidate molecules. A drug in the platform is understood as any bioactive molecule with drug-like properties included in the EMBL-EBI ChEMBL database. All ChEMBL molecules fullfilling any of the next criteria are included in the database: a) Molecules with a known indication. b) Molecules with a known mechanism of action c) ChEMBL molecules included in the DrugBank database d) Molecules that are acknowledged as chemical probes

fields.name: pharmacogenomics
fields.description: Pharmacogenomics data linking genetic variants to responses to this drug. Data is integrated from sources including ClinPGx and describes how genetic variants influence individual responses to this drug.
